doc.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12

title: Ray Miller's Black and White Melody Boys and the Whiteman connection
summary: Photos of Ray Miller's recording band with Tom; discussion of whether Gussie appears and his time with Paul Whiteman.

bands.name: Ray Miller's Black and White Melody Boys

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Nah. Uh, this is Ray Miller, Melody King and his black and white Melody Boys, phonograph artist.
There's five of them here. That's a, I recognize Tom right there.
And they are wonderful records too. I think I have underneath the Wiley and Skars. That's a very pretty, pretty thing.
Then I come across some of those I don't know.
That's Paul Whiteman's band. Gussie might have been in there.
I was looking for that when I was picking him out today. I don't see Gussie there.
Although he did play with Paul.
He was with him around that time, but it must have been right before or right after.
So. So. In the early records, there's only six guys there with Ray Miller, Melody King.
Mm-hmm. Well, sometimes I'm quitting. I don't. Just like Mr. going in. The other one drops out. The other one drops in. Isn't that right?
